titles: The Ozone Hole Is Healing. When Will It Close?
How the World Started Fixing the Ozone Layer
meta.summary: CFCs from fridges and sprays damaged the ozone layer. The 1987 Montreal Protocol phased them out. The 2026 UNEP/WMO Scientific Assessment expects recovery around 2040 for most of the world and during the 2060s over Antarctica. It no longer gives a specific Arctic return year.

sources: NOAA CSL: Scientific Assessment of Ozone Depletion 2026
UNEP Ozone Secretariat, Montreal Protocol Article 15
meta.verdict: Recovery is on track if compliance continues. Most of the world around 2040; Antarctica during the 2060s.
meta.notes: Retention rebuild + fact-check fix. Antarctic wording is 'during the 2060s'; Arctic ~2045 row dropped.
